run_download_images: run the script to download MMRB2 images from HuggingFace to the current directory
run_download_images_to_dir: run the script with --output_dir to download MMRB2 images to a custom path
run_download_images_custom_repo: run the script with --repo to download images from a different HuggingFace repository
refactor_download_and_extract: refactor the download_and_extract function to support parallel downloads of multiple zip files
review_download_and_extract: review the download_and_extract function for error handling and zip extraction logic
